name: Even PTT Reader Simulator
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if ! pgrep -f "[v]ite" >/dev/null; then nohup npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/even-ptt-vite.log 2>&1 & fi; if ! pgrep -f "[e]venhub-simulator" >/dev/null; then sleep 3; nohup npm run sim:headless >/tmp/even-ptt-simulator.log 2>&1 & fi'
